issue.title: Specify fixed-point scoring semantics v1 and wire per-residual quantization error reporting
issue.body:
This PR freezes a single, versioned fixed-point scoring contract for integer runtime accumulation (order, saturation, sentinels, tie-breaking, contribution taxonomy, no-double-counting), and aligns runtime/reporting surfaces to that contract. It also adds compile-time quantization error reporting per residual kind so certification artifacts can track `D(·,·) ≤ ε` evidence without runtime error computation.

- **Normative scoring semantics (versioned)**
  - Added `docs/transformerless/FIXED_POINT_SCORING_SEMANTICS_V1.md`.
  - Defines canonical `ScoreQ` semantics for:
    - typed residual kinds (`transition`, `emission`, `goal`, `constraint`, `uncertainty`)
    - canonical contribution order
    - saturating arithmetic boundary behavior
    - sentinel ordering
    - deterministic selection tie-break (`score desc`, `TokenId asc`)
    - overlap residualization/no-double-counting contract.

- **no_std canonical scoring surface in runtime**
  - Added `crates/uor-r4-graph-runtime/src/scoring.rs` and exported it from `lib.rs`.
  - Introduces:
    - `ResidualKind`
    - `ScoreSentinel` + `OrderedScore` total ordering
    - `TypedContribution`
    - `sort_contributions_canonical(...)`
    - `accumulate_reference(...)` (duplicate evidence-id rejection + saturating accumulation)
    - `select_best(...)` (canonical tie-break).

- **Per-residual-kind quantization error telemetry (compile-time)**
  - Extended `crates/uor-r4-graph-certify/src/score.rs`:
    - Added `QuantizationErrorStats`.
    - Added `compile_transitions_with_quantization(...)` and kept `compile_transitions(...)` as compatibility wrapper.
    - Recorded quantization stats for:
      - transition weights
      - root prior (incl. floor)
      - emission residuals
      - exact-context residuals.
    - Threaded stats through `ScoredGraphInfo` / `ScoredGraphSections`.
  - Extended `ScoreReportQuantization` with `residual_kind_errors` rows (`kind`, `cid`, sample count, max/mean abs error).
  - Bumped report schema to `8`.

- **Call-site wiring updates**
  - Updated graph compilation/reporting call sites to pass transition quantization stats:
    - `crates/uor-r4-graph-cli/src/lib.rs`
    - `crates/uor-r4-core/src/transformerless/cover_sweep.rs`
    - `tests/status_policy_common/mod.rs` fixture construction.

Example of the canonical runtime API introduced:

```rust
let mut contributions = [
    TypedContribution { evidence_id: 1, kind: ResidualKind::Transition, value: ScoreQ::from_raw(12) },
    TypedContribution { evidence_id: 2, kind: ResidualKind::Emission,   value: ScoreQ::from_raw(-3) },
];
sort_contributions_canonical(&mut contributions);
let total = accumulate_reference(ScoreQ::ZERO, &contributions)?;
let (token, score) = select_best(&[
    (7, OrderedScore::Real(total)),
    (9, OrderedScore::Real(total)), // tie -> token 7 wins
]).unwrap();
```

- Fixes #158

reviews.body:
## Pull request overview This PR formalizes a versioned fixed-point scoring contract and aligns the runtime/compiler/reporting surfaces to it by adding a canonical runtime scoring API and emitting compile-time quantization error telemetry per residual kind for score reports/certification. **Changes:** - Added a normative scoring-semantics v1 document under `docs/transformerless/`. - Introduced a `no_std` runtime scoring surface (`ResidualKind`, `OrderedScore`, canonical sorting/accumulation, deterministic tie-break). - Extended compile-time scoring compilation and score reporting to collect and serialize per-residual-kind quantization error stats, wiring the new fields through key call sites. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/status_policy_common/mod.rs | Updates score-graph fixture construction to provide default quantization stats fields. | | docs/transformerless/FIXED_POINT_SCORING_SEMANTICS_V1.md | Adds the normative v1 fixed-point scoring semantics spec. | | crates/uor-r4-graph-runtime/src/scoring.rs | Adds canonical runtime scoring types and reference sorting/accumulation/selection utilities (with unit tests). | | crates/uor-r4-graph-runtime/src/lib.rs | Exports the new `scoring` module from the runtime crate. | | crates/uor-r4-graph-cli/src/lib.rs | Wires transition quantization stats through the CLI scoring command path. | | crates/uor-r4-graph-certify/src/score.rs | Implements quantization error aggregation and extends report schema to include per-kind quantization rows. | | crates/uor-r4-core/src/transformerless/cover_sweep.rs | Wires transition quantization stats through the cover sweep scoring path. |
Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1) **crates/uor-r4-graph-runtime/src/scoring.rs:176** * This test only covers adjacent duplicate `evidence_id`s. Add a non-adjacent duplicate case (optionally after `sort_contributions_canonical`) to prevent regressions where duplicates across kinds slip through. ``` fn duplicate_evidence_is_rejected() { let contributions = [ TypedContribution { evidence_id: 3, kind: ResidualKind::Emission, value: ScoreQ::from_raw(4), }, TypedContribution { evidence_id: 3, kind: ResidualKind::Transition, value: ScoreQ::from_raw(5), }, ]; ```

review_comments.body:
`accumulate_reference` only rejects duplicate `evidence_id` values when they are adjacent in the slice. With the documented canonical sort `(kind, evidence_id)`, the same `evidence_id` can appear multiple times separated by other kinds and will not be rejected, violating the no-double-counting contract.

This issue also appears on line 164 of the same file.

review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+# Fixed-point scoring semantics v1 (normative)
+
+Version: `score-semantics-v1`  
+Status: active for compiler-emitted integer scoring paths.
+
+## Definition
+
+- Canonical score carrier: `ScoreQ(i32)` Q16.16.
+- Runtime scoring inputs are compiler-emitted quantized residuals only.
+- Runtime arithmetic is integer-only accumulation (`saturating_add`/`saturating_sub`) with deterministic table reads and integer comparisons.
+- Runtime scoring performs no coefficient multiplication, division, softmax, floating normalization, or runtime rescaling.
+
+## Objective
+
+Freeze one reproducible semantic contract for score accumulation, ordering, sentinels, and overlap accounting so scalar and optimized kernels can be differentially tested bit-for-bit.
+
+## Guarantee (Structural)
+
+### G1 — Residual taxonomy
+
+Typed contribution kinds are:
+
+1. transition residuals
+2. emission residuals
+3. goal rewards
+4. constraint penalties
+5. uncertainty penalties
+
+`/home/runner/work/uor-r4/uor-r4/crates/uor-r4-graph-runtime/src/scoring.rs` is the canonical no_std type surface for this taxonomy.
review_comments.body: This doc references an absolute CI-specific filesystem path, which won’t be meaningful to readers and will break if the repo is checked out elsewhere. Prefer a repo-relative path (optionally as a Markdown link).
